what: [SCOPE-REDUCTION] Thin wrappers may delegate to another Python module
scenario_or_breakage: The existing migration contract makes python/cli.py the canonical entrypoint for external consumers in docs/python-migration.md:9-14; allowing shell wrappers to call arbitrary modules weakens that contract and adds flexibility the issue did not request
suggested_fix: Require thin wrappers to delegate to python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/python/cli.py" ...; keep hook and CI/pre-commit glue exceptions separate

what: [SCOPE-REDUCTION] Rule paths include .github/workflows/**/* even though scope asks for .sh edit-point visibility
scenario_or_breakage: The new rule would fire on workflow YAML and requirements text changes that are not larch script edits; the CI glue exception can be documented in rule text without broadening the trigger surface
suggested_fix: Drop .github/workflows/**/* and the matching edge-case bullet; keep the CI/pre-commit glue exception in AGENTS.md, the rule body, and docs/python-migration.md
